readerEvidence.summary: Astra single-pass full14-page reading (2 question+12 official solution pages), all four complete keys and all four rubrics. Four whole original IDs retained; genuine question paragraphs become native parts. Original question radial-velocity diagram, four solution diagrams and full supplied stellar-reference table (also transcribed into four native tables) on both relevant pages personally inspected as final no-snap crops. Source errors remain explicit; no separate model checker.
sourceDiscrepancies: Question cover prints XVIII while key prints XIX; primary cover retained. Repeated key problem2 adds observer story and B0III spectral class absent from primary question, retained in source evidence and official solution argument.
Problem1 prints205265 arcseconds on page1,206265 on page2; a/2 cube-root and total-a numerical inconsistency retained. Apoastron-duration numerator uses jp and prints182200s, both retained.
Problem2 calls approaching primary positive radial velocity; printed P approximately3x10^6sec,91.6h,3.82days inconsistent conversion retained.
Problem3 printed magnitude logarithm lacks factor2.5 but result is-10m; says absolute solar magnitude, retained as printed.

Problem4 lunar magnitude prints double equality and no minus sign in key, despite negative value in supplied data. Final t denominator is omegaJupiter while594s follows preceding relative speed; source formula retained.
